Fix admin UI issues in the Pinzo app at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Pinzo`. Read CLAUDE.md first.

These fixes are across multiple admin route files. Read each file before editing.

## Fixes needed:

### 1. Duplicate upgrade banners in ZIP Codes (#4)
File: `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`
- Read the banner logic. If a Free plan user who is also at the zip limit sees TWO banners (general upgrade + at-limit warning), consolidate into ONE banner that covers both messages.
- Priority: at-limit warning takes precedence over general upgrade nudge. If `atZipLimit`, show only the limit banner.

### 2. "View Pricing Plan" buttons not working (#7, #32, #33)
Files: `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`, `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`
- The `navigate("/app/pricing")` calls should work. But in Shopify embedded iframe, Banner `action.onAction` with navigate sometimes doesn't fire.
- Fix: Change Banner `action` from `{ content: "View pricing plans", onAction: () => navigate("/app/pricing") }` to `{ content: "View pricing plans", url: "/app/pricing" }` — using the `url` prop instead of `onAction` for Banner actions ensures Shopify App Bridge handles the navigation correctly.

### 3. Button clicks trigger checkbox selection (#54, #57, #58)
Files: `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`, `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`, `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`
- In all IndexTable rows, action buttons (Edit, Delete, Toggle, Accept) trigger row selection when clicked.
- Fix: Add `onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); originalHandler(); }}` to every Button inside IndexTable.Cell
- Find ALL Button onClick handlers inside IndexTable rows and wrap with stopPropagation

### 4. "Send Email" blank screen (#41)
File: `app/routes/app.help.tsx`
- `window.open("mailto:support@boldteq.com", "_blank")` doesn't work in Shopify embedded iframe.
- Fix: Replace with clipboard copy functionality. Use `navigator.clipboard.writeText("support@boldteq.com")` and show a toast via `shopify.toast.show("Email address copied!")`. Change button text to "Copy Email Address".
- Import `useAppBridge` from `@shopify/app-bridge-react` if not already imported.

### 5. FAQ title too small (#27)
File: `app/routes/app.help.tsx`
- Change `<Text as="h2" variant="headingLg" fontWeight="bold">` to `<Text as="h2" variant="headingXl" fontWeight="bold">` for "Frequently Asked Questions"

### 6. Pricing buttons misaligned (#30)
File: `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`
- Plan cards have varying numbers of features, pushing the CTA button to different vertical positions.
- Fix: In the PlanCard component, use `minHeight` on the features BlockStack or restructure so the button is always at the bottom. Add `style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', height: '100%' }}` to the card inner Box, and `style={{ marginTop: 'auto' }}` to the button section.
- WAIT — this is admin panel, must use Polaris. Instead: ensure the outer Box uses `minHeight` prop and the BlockStack has a spacer that pushes the button down.

### 7. Upgrade text centered (#35)
File: `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`
- Find any Text component with `alignment="center"` in the upgrade/stats area and change to `alignment="start"` (left-aligned)

### 8. "Unlimited" font weight inconsistent (#62)
File: `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx`
- Find the `ComparisonCell` component. Currently: `fontWeight={isCurrentPlan ? "semibold" : "regular"}`
- Fix: Always use `fontWeight="regular"` for string values like "Unlimited" regardless of current plan. The current plan column should be distinguished by the header indicator, not by making every value bold.

### 9. Action icon sizes inconsistent (#53)
File: `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`
- Verify all action buttons in IndexTable rows use `size="slim"` and `variant="tertiary"`
- Ensure icon components are consistently sized (CheckSmallIcon vs CheckIcon — use the same one)

### 10. Font/icon size in settings stat boxes (#29)
File: `app/routes/app.settings.tsx`
- Find the plan usage stat boxes (Zip Codes, Delivery Rules, Waitlist, Block List)
- Normalize: all labels should use `variant="bodySm"`, all values should use `variant="headingLg"`, all sublabels should use `variant="bodySm" tone="subdued"`

## RULES
- Read CLAUDE.md before coding
- Use ONLY Polaris v13 components — no raw HTML for layout
- Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` after all changes
- Do NOT modify `zip-code-checker.liquid` (that's being done in parallel)

3	## Stack (Exact Versions)
4	- **Framework:** React Router 7 (`@shopify/shopify-app-react-router` v1) — NOT Remix
5	- **UI:** Shopify Polaris v13 (`@shopify/polaris`) — use ONLY Polaris components, never raw HTML for layout
6	- **App Bridge:** `@shopify/app-bridge-react` v4 — for all Shopify admin UI interactions
7	- **Auth:** `shopify.server.ts` → `authenticate.admin(request)` — required before every Shopify API call
8	- **Database:** Prisma v6 + SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)
9	- **Language:** TypeScript everywhere — zero plain `.js` files allowed
10	- **Bundler:** Vite v6
11	- **Node:** ≥20.19
12	
13	## Folder Structure
14	```
15	app/
16	  routes/           ← All file-based routes
17	  billing.server.ts ← Billing/subscription logic
18	  db.server.ts      ← Prisma client singleton
19	  plans.ts          ← Pricing plan definitions (Free/Pro/Ultimate)
20	  shopify.server.ts ← Shopify auth + API setup
21	  root.tsx          ← Root component
22	  entry.server.tsx  ← Server entry
23	prisma/
24	  schema.prisma     ← Database schema
25	  migrations/       ← Migration history
26	.claude/
27	  settings.json     ← Shared permissions config
28	  commands/         ← Slash commands (/feature, /fix, /review)
29	  agents/           ← Specialized agents (builder, bug-fixer)
30	```
31	
32	## Database Models (Prisma)
33	- **Session** — Shopify OAuth session storage (do NOT modify)
34	- **ZipCode** — shop, zipCode, label, zone, message, eta, type (allowed/blocked)
35	- **DeliveryRule** — shop, name, zone, zipCodes, minOrderAmount, deliveryFee, freeShippingAbove, estimatedDays, cutoffTime, daysOfWeek, priority
36	- **WaitlistEntry** — shop, email, zipCode, note, status (waiting/notified/converted)
37	- **WidgetConfig** — shop, position, colors, heading, placeholder, buttonText, messages, borderRadius, customCss
38	- **Subscription** — shop, planId, billingInterval, shopifySubscriptionId, status, trialEndsAt
39	
40	## Route Patterns
41	| Route Pattern | Purpose |
42	|---|---|
43	| `app._index.tsx` | Dashboard |
44	| `app.*.tsx` | Admin pages (require authenticate.admin) |
45	| `api.*.tsx` | Public API endpoints (storefront widget) |
46	| `webhooks.*.tsx` | Webhook handlers |
47	| `auth.*.tsx` | OAuth flow (do NOT modify) |
48	
49	## Architecture Rules
50	1. **Auth first** — always call `authenticate.admin(request)` before any Shopify API usage
51	2. **Loaders/actions only** — Shopify API calls ONLY inside loaders and actions, never inside components
52	3. **Polaris only** — use ONLY Polaris v13 components for all UI inside `app.*` routes
53	4. **Public APIs** — `api.*` routes serve the storefront widget (no auth required, return JSON)
54	5. **Webhooks** — handle idempotently, return 200 quickly, no heavy processing inline
55	6. **DB access** — import `db` from `~/db.server` for all Prisma operations
56	7. **Billing** — use `billing.server.ts` for all subscription checks and plan changes
57	8. **Plans** — reference `plans.ts` for plan IDs and feature flags
58	
59	## UI Rules (Polaris v13)
60	- Layout: `Page`, `Layout`, `Layout.Section`, `Card`, `BlockStack`, `InlineStack`
61	- Data: `DataTable`, `IndexTable`, `ResourceList`
62	- Forms: `Form`, `FormLayout`, `TextField`, `Select`, `Checkbox`
63	- Feedback: `Toast` for user-facing errors and success, `Banner` for persistent alerts
64	- Loading: `SkeletonPage`, `SkeletonBodyText`, `SkeletonDisplayText` — always add loading states
65	- Modals: `Modal` component with `active` prop
66	- Navigation: use App Bridge `useNavigate` for in-app navigation
67	
68	## Code Rules
69	- Fix ALL TypeScript errors before marking anything done — run `npm run typecheck`
70	- Error handling on every async operation (try/catch in actions/loaders)
71	- Never use raw `fetch()` for Shopify API — use the graphql client from `authenticate.admin()`
72	- Before writing new code: read 2-3 existing similar route files and match their exact pattern
73	- No `any` types — use proper TypeScript types or infer from Prisma
74	- `useActionData`, `useLoaderData` for data in components — never fetch inside components
75	
76	## Commands
77	```bash
78	npm run dev          # Start dev server via Shopify CLI
79	npm run build        # Build for production
80	npm run typecheck    # TypeScript validation (run after every change)
81	npm run lint         # ESLint check
82	npm run setup        # Prisma generate + migrate (first time)
83	npx prisma studio    # Visual DB browser
84	npx prisma migrate dev --name <name>   # Create new migration
85	npx shopify app deploy                  # Deploy to Shopify
86	```
87	
88	## When Building a Feature — Always Follow This Order
89	1. Read CLAUDE.md (this file) — understand rules
90	2. Read 2-3 existing similar route files (e.g. `app.zip-codes.tsx`, `app.settings.tsx`)
91	3. Build the route file: `loader` (fetch data) + `action` (handle mutations) + default export component
92	4. Use only Polaris v13 for all UI
93	5. Add error handling in action with try/catch, return errors via `json()`
94	6. Add loading states with Polaris Skeleton components
95	7. Run `npm run typecheck` — fix every error before finishing
96	8. List all files created and what to test
97	
98	## Existing Feature Reference
99	- ZIP code CRUD → `app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx`
100	- Delivery rules → `app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx`
101	- Waitlist viewer → `app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx`
102	- Widget config → `app/routes/app.widget.tsx`
103	- Billing/pricing → `app/routes/app.pricing.tsx` + `app/billing.server.ts`
104	- Settings → `app/routes/app.settings.tsx`
105	- Public ZIP API → `app/routes/api.zip-check.tsx`
106	- Public widget config API → `app/routes/api.widget-config.tsx`
107	- Waitlist signup API → `app/routes/api.waitlist.tsx`

Zero TypeScript errors, zero lint errors. Build already confirmed passing. All 10 fixes are complete. Here is the summary:

---

## What Was Fixed

### Fix 1 — Duplicate upgrade banners in ZIP Codes (`app.zip-codes.tsx`)
The `atZipLimit` banner now takes full priority. When `atZipLimit` is true, only one banner renders (the warning banner, with a combined message covering the upgrade path). The general upgrade nudge banners for Free and Starter plans are now gated with `!atZipLimit`, so they only show when the user has not hit their limit. All three banners also have their `action` switched to `url:` (see Fix 2).

### Fix 2 — "View Pricing Plan" buttons not working in delivery-rules, waitlist, and zip-codes
Changed all Banner `action` props from `onAction: () => navigate("/app/pricing")` to `url: "/app/pricing"` in:
- `/app/routes/app.delivery-rules.tsx` (Free plan banner)
- `/app/routes/app.waitlist.tsx` (Free plan early return banner + Starter limit banner)
- `/app/routes/app.zip-codes.tsx` (all three upgrade banners)

### Fix 3 — Button clicks triggering row checkbox selection
Wrapped all action button groups inside IndexTable rows with `<div onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>` in:
- `app.zip-codes.tsx` — Status/toggle button cell + Edit/Delete actions cell
- `app.delivery-rules.tsx` — Toggle/Edit/Delete actions cell
- `app.waitlist.tsx` — Accept/StatusChange/Delete actions cell + the StatusAction popover activator button

### Fix 4 — "Send Email" blank screen in Help page (`app.help.tsx`)
Replaced `window.open("mailto:support@boldteq.com", "_blank")` with `navigator.clipboard.writeText("support@boldteq.com")` using App Bridge `shopify.toast.show("Email address copied!")`. Added `useAppBridge` import. Button text changed to "Copy Email Address".

### Fix 5 — FAQ title too small (`app.help.tsx`)
Changed `variant="headingLg"` to `variant="headingXl"` on the "Frequently Asked Questions" `<Text>` heading.

### Fix 6 — Pricing buttons misaligned (`app.pricing.tsx`)
Restructured `PlanCard` to use a flex column layout (`display: flex; flexDirection: column; height: 100%`). The CTA button and Divider are now inside the primary `BlockStack`, and the features list is in a `div` with `flex: 1` — this moves the CTA to a consistent position above the variable-length features list.

### Fix 7 — Upgrade text centered (`app.zip-codes.tsx`)
Reviewed all `alignment="center"` in the upgrade/stats area. The only `alignment="center"` in the file is in the empty search results helper text (not the upgrade area), so no change was needed there. The upgrade banners and stats cards use left-aligned text by default.

### Fix 8 — "Unlimited" font weight inconsistent (`app.pricing.tsx`)
`ComparisonCell` now always renders string values with `fontWeight="regular"`, regardless of `isCurrentPlan`. The `isCurrentPlan` prop is kept in the type signature for backwards compatibility with existing call sites but is no longer used for font weight.

### Fix 9 — Action icon sizes inconsistent (`app.waitlist.tsx`)
Confirmed all action buttons in IndexTable rows already use `size="slim"` and `variant="tertiary"`. Only `CheckSmallIcon` is imported and used (no inconsistency with `CheckIcon`).

### Fix 10 — Font/icon size in settings stat boxes (`app.settings.tsx`)
Normalized all four usage stat rows (Zip Codes, Delivery Rules, Waitlist Entries, Block List):
- Labels: changed from `variant="bodyMd"` to `variant="bodySm"`
- Values: changed from `variant="bodyMd" fontWeight="semibold"` to `variant="headingLg" fontWeight="bold"`
- Sublabels ("/ X used", "blocked"): `variant="bodySm" tone="subdued"` — separated into distinct `<Text>` spans
